# Duo Model Compatibility Sources

These Python sources support compatible Duo checkpoints. They provide token
serialization, sequence layouts, sampling, checkpoint restore,
and clean-KV behavior required by compatible Duo checkpoints. Existing
copyright and license notices are preserved. The source revision did not
include a top-level license, and inclusion here does not assign a new license
to these files or to model weights. TorchTitan-derived files retain their
BSD-style notices. Review the applicable upstream and model-provider terms
before redistribution. No weights, datasets, or media are included.
